lines.t: Been a long, dusty road I’ve been ridin’,
Chasin’ dreams that always fade with the dawn.
But in the stillness, I heard You callin’,
A whisper of mercy sayin’, “Child, come home.”
The world had my heart, but You bought it back,
With love no shadow can undo.
Yahushua, You’re the fire in my soul,
The anchor that steadies when the wild winds blow.
You found me lost, now I’m made brand new,
Forever I’m ridin’ home to You.
Your truth like rain on a thirsty field,
Your word cuts deep, but it’s how I heal.
In Your light, all my fears give way,
And joy like sunrise fills my days.
You took my shame and turned it into song,
Now every breath sings where I belong.
Yahushua, You’re the fire in my soul,
The anchor that steadies when the wild winds blow.
You found me lost, now I’m made brand new,
Forever I’m ridin’ home to You.
No silver, no gold can match Your grace,
You’re my Savior, my heart’s resting place.
When this life fades and the skies turn blue,
I’ll see the gates… and run to You.
Yahushua, You’re the fire in my soul,
The anchor that steadies when the wild winds blow.
You found me lost, now I’m made brand new,
Forever I’m ridin’ home…
Forever I’m ridin’ home to You.
Yeah, forever I’m ridin’ home to You.
